errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the data is for Great Britain ('Великобритания'). The paper title mentions Bulgaria, and the chart itself does not specify a country, making this an unsubstantiated addition.
The markers for the green line representing "Автомобилен транспорт" are diamond-shaped, not circular ('кръгли').

This part of the description refers to "Железопътен транспорт" (Rail transport). The chart shows its value in 2012 is 10.1%, not 4.9%. The value 4.9% corresponds to "Воден транспорт" (Water transport) in 2012.

The description of the line for "Железопътен транспорт" (Rail transport) as a continuous ('непрекъснат') decline is an over-generalization. The line shows slight increases between 2002-2003 (from 33.0 to 33.9) and 2005-2006 (from 24.5 to 26.2).

This part of the description refers to "Воден транспорт" (Water transport). The chart shows its value in 2012 is 4.9%, not 10.1%. The value 10.1% corresponds to "Железопътен транспорт" (Rail transport). Additionally, the line starts at 3.2%, so stating it is 'decreasing' to 10.1% is logically incorrect.

errors.text_span: Тя също показва спад, с леко възходящ тренд в периода 2009-2012 г.
errors.evidence: This description of the trend for "Воден транспорт" (Water transport) is incorrect. The overall trend is not a decline ('спад'), as it starts at 3.2% and ends at 4.9%. Furthermore, the trend in the period 2009-2012 is clearly downward (from 7.9% to 4.9%), not upward ('възходящ').
